'''Embaril''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Embaril system/Legends|Embaril system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Embaril lay on the [[Cadinth Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Cadinth system/Legends|Cadinth]] and [[Voss system/Legends|Voss systems]], and its surface featured [[Color/Legends|green]] hills and [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Water/Legends|lakes]]. It was among the Tion Cluster's least-spoiled worlds, and affluent [[Noble/Legends|aristocrats]] from the [[Star cluster/Legends|cluster]] and beyond were drawn to Embaril by its scenery.<ref name="Xim" />

For [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] ruler [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] at some point around [[25,100 BBY]], Embaril was under the rule of [[Jaminere Marches]], a state centered on the world [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]].<ref name="Xim" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Embaril's hills and lakes were represented as a faded [[holograph]] at the booths of the [[Orman's Sky Palace]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on the planet [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], one of the establishment's several such recreations of sights from the Allied Tion [[Sector/Legends|sector]] worlds.<ref name="Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Embaril was introduced in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', a [[1992]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure authored by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]].<ref name="Lianna" /> The [[December 7]], [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]] placed it in grid square S-6.<ref name="Xim" />
